messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: HOSTED-API us-west1 — streaming responses experiencing high tail latency and intermittent stalls. p95 spike to ~1.1s (SLO 200ms), p99 ~6.3s. Error spike: proxy 504s and client reconnects. Starting incident thread 1837654321.
sarah (oncall): ack — I'm on it. Adding context: any affected routes/paths?
nate (eng-runtime): seeing elevated queue length on streaming workers for model rdx-small-4k, KV-cache miss rate up ~40%. Proxy logs show repeated "upstream timed out" for /v1/stream endpoints.
lina (eng-sre): thanks @sarah @nate — dashboards show egress proxied connections hitting keepalive exhaustion on the streaming proxy pool (proxy-ssw-*) and proxy CPU at 85%.
dan (customer-success): FYI we already have two paying customers who've reported reconnects and partial responses in last 10m. I can DM churn-risk list if needed.
sarah (oncall): initial mitigation plan: 1) scale streaming proxy pool +12 instances 2) reduce proxy keepalive timeout to force faster connection turnover 3) enable immediate chunk flush on proxy for SSE endpoints 4) canary fallback to non-streaming chunked responses for VIP customers. Thoughts?
nate (eng-runtime): agree. Also recommend temporarily enable KV-cache warming (prefetch hot prefixes) and lower batch aggregation window from 20ms -> 8ms to reduce tail.
lina (eng-sre): scaling now: issuing scale up on proxy autoscaler — expected 90s to have capacity. Lowering keepalive to 30s on proxies now (applied).
sarah (oncall): opsbot, please set page to eng-runtime and eng-sre on-call post-update and add incident tag streaming-tail-latency.
opsbot: done — @nate (eng-runtime) and @lina (eng-sre) paged. Incident label streaming-tail-latency applied.
nate (eng-runtime): rolling patch to proxy config to flush chunks earlier (proxy.conf: chunk_flush_interval=10ms) — rolling 20% at a time. Patch command: ```kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/proxy-ssw --selector=zone=us-west1 --timeout=120s```
opsbot: rollout 20% started.
dan (customer-success): I told affected customers we're investigating and gave ETA ~15m for mitigation. One reported repeated SSE reconnects and partial JSON payloads.
ate (eng-runtime): logs from proxy showing pattern: repeated long-held connections with zero bytes read for >5s then 504. Sample: ```[proxy-ssw-4] 2026-03-14T18:12:02Z upstream timed out after 5000ms reading response header from upstream```
sarah (oncall): can we temporarily route new streaming sessions to us-east1 as fallback? Risk: slightly higher latency for some customers but avoids stalls.
lina (eng-sre): we can add routing rule in 60s via traffic-router: set policy route=region:prefer(us-east1) for route /v1/stream where customer not pinned. Doing that for non-enterprise traffic.
opsbot: traffic rule applied to 45% of traffic -> us-east1 fallback.
nate (eng-runtime): small additional mitigation: cap max concurrent streaming frames per connection to 32 to avoid long-running holed connections. Applying in runtime config now.
sarah (oncall): update: p95 down to ~420ms, p99 fallen to 1.8s after scaling + routing change. Still seeing occasional stalls for some clients.
dan (customer-success): one affected customer reports improved behavior but some reconnects persisted for mobile clients on flaky networks. They're asking for a timeline.
sarah (oncall): ETA for full rollback of keepalive change and chunk flush tuning? We'll hold config until stable for 30m, then revert if safe. If stable, start incident close flow.
nate (eng-runtime): will keep monitoring. Also queued a follow-up to add better streaming backpressure metrics (client RX/TX per connection, idle-time histograms).
lina (eng-sre): note for postmortem: root cause likely proxy keepalive exhaustion + unexpected client backpressure (mobile slow readers) causing worker queue buildup. Action items: 1) increase proxy pool autoscale headroom 2) implement per-connection idle-kick 3) improve KV-cache prefetching for hot prefixes 4) add streaming SLO dashboard for p50/p95/p99 by connection age.
sarah (oncall): customer-impact summary for postmortem: "Intermittent streaming stalls and reconnects for hosted-api us-west1 between 18:10-18:45 UTC. A subset of customers saw partial responses and reconnects; observable p99 degraded to ~6s. No data loss, but user-facing instability and retries increased. CS notified top impacted accounts."
dan (customer-success): I'll draft the customer-facing note and sync with legal if needed.
sarah (oncall): handing off to @nate for follow-up work and long-lived action items. I'll remain in watch for 1 hour. If anything regresses, re-page me.
nate (eng-runtime): taking ownership of post-incident follow-ups. Adding tasks to runtime backlog and scheduling a focused sprint next week.
opsbot: incident severity reduced to SEV-2. Logged timeline and added incident ticket INC-2026-1837654321.
sarah (oncall): thanks team — marking incident as mitigated for now. Will open postmortem doc and assign owners. :white_check_mark:
